It's relieving, but this isn't an all time high; it's a recovery from 2024-25. I said as much in the first entry I ever logged here, which is the same entry where I set the goal. What I never did was show the damage.

It isn't visible on the main charts on this site either. I launched in 2026, and IB's Flex Queries only hand back a trailing year, so the site's own history doesn't start until April 2025.

However, we can reconstruct most of the data from old statements. We had a really nice 2022-23, where I had a lot of confidence I could beat the SPX with some very strong metrics.

    <circle cx="185.8" cy="299.6" r="4" fill="#ff4fd8"/>
    <line x1="185.8" y1="291.6" x2="185.8" y2="147.4" stroke="#ff4fd8" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>
    <text x="194.8" y="153.4" font-size="11" fill="var(--fg-2,#c4b5d4)">10 may 2024 &#183; the last high, +5.6%</text>
    <text x="194.8" y="167.4" font-size="10" fill="var(--fg-4,#8b7aa8)">two sessions later it lost 36.9% in a single day</text>
    <text x="194.8" y="181.4" font-size="10" fill="var(--fg-4,#8b7aa8)">then it got bigger: 1.6% daily vol before 10 may, 2.8% in the eleven weeks after</text>

    <line x1="273.9" y1="354.5" x2="273.9" y2="196.7" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>
    <text x="282.9" y="202.7" font-size="11" fill="var(--fg-2,#c4b5d4)">5 aug 2024 &#183; &#8722;53.2%, a 55.6% drawdown</text>
    <circle cx="526.7" cy="357.1" r="4" fill="#a78bfa"/>
    <line x1="526.7" y1="349.1" x2="526.7" y2="297.4" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>
    <text x="535.7" y="303.4" font-size="11" fill="var(--fg-2,#c4b5d4)">7 apr 2025 &#183; &#8722;24.1% in one session</text>
    <text x="535.7" y="317.4" font-size="10" fill="var(--fg-4,#8b7aa8)">the index bottomed the next day. the book</text>
    <text x="535.7" y="331.4" font-size="10" fill="var(--fg-4,#8b7aa8)">bled nine more: &#8722;8.9% to the index&#8217;s +1.9%.</text>
    <text x="50" y="412" font-size="10.5" letter-spacing="0.14em" fill="var(--fg-3,#a99bc0)">RISK WAS 4x HIGHER ON THE WAY DOWN THAN ON THE WAY BACK UP</text>
    <text x="50" y="428" font-size="10.5" fill="var(--fg-4,#8b7aa8)">21-session realised vol &#183; the book&#8217;s own daily moves. backward-looking, so its spikes sit just after the losses.</text>

First there was being short into the GME meme squeeze of May 2024, then being overleveraged into the yen carry scare of summer 2024, and then being overly short vol in the tariffs of April 2025. The worst part about all of these trades is I derisked near the bottom when my position would've recovered if it was kept. But the real strategy likely would've been to derisk much earlier, before I decided the amount of leverage had an unacceptable amount of risk for account implosion.
